<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Let me try UP with intent='solve' to bypass state graph
f = current_frame
before_lines = f.ascii.split('\n')

result = action(['UP'], intent='solve')
t = last_transition
after = t.after_frame
after_lines = after.ascii.split('\n')

changed = []
for r in range(64):
    if before_lines[r] != after_lines[r]:
        for c in range(64):
            if before_lines[r][c] != after_lines[r][c]:
                changed.append((r, c, before_lines[r][c], after_lines[r][c]))

print(f"UP: changed={len(changed)} cells, reward={result.get('reward')}, done={result.get('done')}")
for r, c, b, a in changed[:30]:
    print(f"  ({r},{c}): {b} -> {a}")
if len(changed) > 30:
    print(f"  ... and {len(changed)-30} more")

# Show rows 22-30, cols 11-47
print("\nRows 22-30, cols 11-47:")
for r in range(22, 31):
    print(f"  row {r}: {after_lines[r][11:47]}")

# Show row 53
print(f"\nRow 53: {after_lines[53][:10]}...")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
